column3: (Public pages use short caching; authenticated app/API routes use private no-store. Revalidate route headers when changed.)
(External scripts are constrained by the explicit CSP allowlist for Firebase/Google, Cloudflare Insights and jsDelivr. Review any new origin.)
(Non-storable content is intentional for user-specific app/API responses protected by private no-store.)
(Timestamp appears in a fingerprinted frontend bundle; verify no secret or sensitive operational metadata is exposed.)
(Technology fingerprint only; not a vulnerability by itself.)
(SRI is not currently applied to SDK-managed dynamic Firebase/Google identity scripts; CSP restricts script origins. Reassess if static third-party scripts are added.)
(COEP is intentionally not enabled pending compatibility requirements for Firebase popup authentication and cross-origin media. Do not enable without browser regression tests.)
